title: Tyreek Hill Could Return to Chiefs in 2026
seoTitle: Tyreek Hill Could Return to Chiefs in 2026
subtitle: The Injury Preventing His Return and Rumors of Kansas City's Interest
excerpt: Tyreek Hill is still unsigned and recovering from a severe injury sustained in 2025, but the Chiefs are rumored as a likely destination if he returns to play.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Tyreek Hill remains unsigned as he recovers from a severe injury sustained early in the 2025 season. The landscape shifted with indications that the Kansas City Chiefs might be the club where he finishes his career, should he manage to return to the field in 2026.

The Possibility of a Reunion with the Chiefs

Several reports point to the Chiefs as the leading candidate to welcome Hill back. The athlete himself has expressed a desire to return to the team that drafted him ten years ago, even posting old images with the caption "Soon my dear friend".

Tyreek Hill's History with the Chiefs

Hill played six seasons for the Chiefs before being traded in 2022. In the trade, the team received draft capital that helped build the roster which won two subsequent Super Bowls, although the wide receiver position became vulnerable.

The Injury Preventing His Return

The player is recovering from an injury described as "absolutely brutal." Videos released over the summer showed that there's still a ways to go, especially considering Hill is 32 years old and already showing physical wear and tear.

Expert Opinions on the Return

Albert Breer, quoted in an interview on The Dan Patrick Show, reiterated that the Chiefs are a "potential suitor." Breer emphasized that Hill wants to play, but the decision regarding the timing and location of his return must be careful.

What's Needed for a Return to the Field

According to Breer's comments, there's no way to definitively say when Hill will be ready to play. The Kansas City team will need to assess the athlete's entry point and how he will fit into the position, which currently features Tyquan Thornton as the primary option.

With information from Arrowhead Addict.
